strings.Parámetros de la estimación del módulo p: Parameters of the module estimate from the module anchors (`app/analysis/location.py`). None is backed for a metal module in flight: they are calibrated on each ship.
strings.Sin respaldo: calibrar en cada nave. La: No backing: calibrate on each ship. The window, the margin, the dwell time, the expiry and the signal threshold are EMMA design parameters. The zone accuracy of BLE measured on Earth (71-85 %, with the errors at the borders between zones) does not carry over to a metal module, where multipath and the body of whoever carries the receiver attenuate and reflect the signal.
strings.La ubicación es un módulo de la lista de: The location is a module from the declared list (`habitat_modules.json`), not a clinical observation: it carries no LOINC code and no code of its own, and it enters neither the indicator catalogue nor the analysis.
strings.Las anclas son equipo de la nave, certif: The anchors are ship equipment, certified and powered by the ship (the pattern of REALM-1 and DLR Wireless Compose). EMMA adds no emitters or batteries: the wearable or the gateway only listen. Feasibility detail in `compliance/location-sensing-feasibility.md`.
strings.NASA JSC, balizas BLE fijas para situar: NASA JSC, fixed BLE beacons to locate an iPad on board (NTRS 20190001027)
strings.Balizas BLE fijas con pila de cinco años: Fixed BLE beacons with a five-year battery and a position of 50-100 cm, motivated by knowing the position on the ISS. Tested on Earth only; at NSRL there were resets and a latch-up at about 7 Gy.
strings.REALM-1: RFID de carga con lectores fijo: REALM-1: cargo RFID with fixed readers in Node 1, Node 2 and the US laboratory
strings.Localización por anclas fijas de la nave: Location by fixed ship anchors in operation on the ISS. It does not use RSSI, because of multipath.
strings.DLR Wireless Compose: UWB en Columbus (2: DLR Wireless Compose: UWB in Columbus (2018-2019)
strings.Cinco anclas UWB y dos etiquetas en el a: Five UWB anchors and two tags on the astronaut. It flew; it does not publish accuracy. It is the alternative with documented flight.
strings.Precisión de zona con BLE en interiores: Zone accuracy with BLE indoors (Hadian 2023; Kiarashi 2023)
strings.71-85 % de acierto de zona en Tierra, co: 71-85 % zone hit rate on Earth, with the errors at the borders.
strings.Precisión de zona con BLE dentro de un m: Zone accuracy with BLE inside a metal module
strings.Restricciones de vuelo: EMC (SSP 30237,: Flight constraints: EMC (SSP 30237, MIL-STD-461) and batteries (JSC 20793)
strings.Todo equipo comercial pasa EMC y toda ba: All commercial equipment goes through EMC and every battery through JSC 20793: that is why the anchors belong to the ship and EMMA adds no emitters.
